session.name: MPI-4 - LTX 2.3 v2v extend PROVEN on the bench; silent sources and 3s foley added; next is the full-clip V2V Foley op

goal.original: Work out what in a third-party LTX_Extend workflow actually makes video extension, then build our own minimal version of it - as few new dependencies as possible.
goal.summary: Done and proven. The single-stage v2v extend workflow executes end to end on the bench against both an H3 clip (with audio) and a WAN 16fps clip (silent), and is committed at comfy_workflows/raw/ltx_v2v_template.json (56 nodes, 101 links). App integration is carded as MPI-520, blocked until 1.4 ships. The NEXT piece of work is a separate op: full-clip V2V Foley, adding sound to any muted video.

completed: Extend mechanism reduced to one node - LTXVAudioVideoMask max_length='pad' zero-pads an encoded reference latent and masks only the padding. Zero new node packs
Workflow EXECUTED for the first time: H3 clip with audio, seam judged acceptable by the user

fps handling: MpiMath#51 floor((a*b+0.5)/8)*8/b snaps the extend tail to the 8n lattice and drives BOTH the mask end time and the audio trim, so video and audio tails are equal at any fps. The +0.5 covers NTSC (23.976 would otherwise drop 72 frames to 64). Removed MpiWanSeconds#22, orphaned and already a pass-through

Resolution settled: the graph honours whatever width/height the app sends; deriving them client-side keeps injection alive. Confirmed keep_proportion='crop' with divisible_by=32 is a PURE crop (no resample) when target == source
Silent sources supported end to end, every audio input switched on MpiLoadVideo.has_audio (5 selectors + EmptyAudio + a Zero node)

Root-caused two bugs the first silent run exposed: AudioConcat returns audio2 alone when audio1 is None (tail audio muxed from t=0 over the reference footage), and LTXVEmptyLatentAudio is torch.zeros which decodes to hiss when the mask leaves it frozen

FOLEY discovered as a free side effect: masking the whole audio stream makes LTX generate audio across the reference window too, conditioned on video it did not make. Verified on the WAN clip - the whole 3.06s got sound including a spoken line, at zero extra sampler cost
Preroll floor MpiMath#60 (a if a>0.001 else 0.001) fixes the crash when a clip sits exactly on the 8n+1 lattice, making it entirely the reference window and the pre-roll exactly 0
Landed comfy_workflows/raw/ltx_v2v_template.json, byte-identical to the copy that ran; created MPI-520; committed 24b5ec44 and pushed

next_action.description: Build the full-clip V2V Foley workflow on the bench - freeze all video, mask all audio, generate no new frames - and give it the same audio input and audio reference sockets the main ltx_i2v_t2v workflow has, so users can supply a reference voice or part of the real audio. Start by reading tasks/MPI-4/brief.md (the section dated 2026-08-10) and the bench's LTX_Extend / LTX_lipdub_v2v_template workflows.

key_decisions: Extend and foley and lipsync are the SAME spine with different mask polarity - extend pads, lipsync does partial, foley freezes the video side. models.js already points two ops at one file, so this needs no new app plumbing

Foley on the EXTEND workflow only covers the reference window (~3s at the 73 cap) because that is all the model sees. Widening it means raising Ref_Frames, which is the cost the cap exists to avoid - hence a separate op. The user explicitly accepted the 3s scope for v2v
The foley op gets audio input + audio reference from the start (user, 2026-08-10), rather than being prompt-only

Keep Input_Width/Input_Height as injectable MpiInt in the REPO copy and derive the default client-side. A link into a widget-input makes ComfyUI ignore the widget, so an in-graph wire would silently kill the app's injected resolution

1ms pre-roll floor beat matching EmptyAudio's sample rate to the decoder, because LTXVAudioVAEDecode reads output_sample_rate off the CHECKPOINT (vocoder.py 444-450), so a hard-coded rate is the more brittle option
constraints: Reference frame counts sit on the 8n+1 lattice (latent frames = ((N-1)//8)+1). Off-lattice does not error - the mask boundary drifts, which reads as a bad seam

LTX 2.3 samples a JOINT AV latent, so the audio path is structural, not optional. But LTXVConcatAVLatent builds a NestedTensor of two INDEPENDENT streams, so there is no video:audio ratio for an odd fps to violate
KJ's mask hardcodes audio_latents_per_second = 16000/160/4 = 25, decoupled from video fps
There is no validate-only endpoint. Do NOT POST to /prompt as a dry run on the user's bench - a 22B model loads before the graph's own ExecutionBlocker stops anything

The user owns the bench browser tab. It holds the graph in memory, so ASK them to close it before editing userdata, and re-fetch immediately before writing - otherwise their next Ctrl+S clobbers the edit
